description_en: Queries the details of a single OSS storage object that is authorized for connection in Data Security Center
description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据安全中心连接授权的OSS的单个存储对象的详细信息
name: DescribeOssObjectDetail

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:
zh_cn: Chinese.
en_us: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。取值：
zh_cn：中文。
en_us：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the OSS storage object.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410152.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储对象的唯一标识ID。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410152.html接口获取ID
parameters.name: id

OssObjectDetail.description_en: The details of the OSS storage object

BucketName.description_en: The name of the bucket to which the OSS storage object belongs

CategoryName.description_en: The object type name of the OSS storage object

Name.description_en: The name of the OSS storage object

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the OSS storage object

RiskLevelName.description_en: The risk level name of the OSS storage object
RiskLevelName.description_zh: OSS存储对象的风险等级名称

RuleList.description_en: The list of sensitive data detection rules that the OSS storage object hits
RuleList.description_zh: OSS存储对象命中的敏感数据识别规则列表

items.description_en: The details of the sensitive data detection rule that is hit
items.description_zh: 命中敏感数据识别规则详情

CategoryName.description_en: The object type name of the OSS storage object

Count.description_en: The number of times the sensitive data detection rule is hit
Count.description_zh: 命中敏感数据识别规则的次数

ModelTags.description_en: The list of data tags for the detection model that is hit
ModelTags.description_zh: 命中识别模型的数据标签列表

items.description_en: The data tag object of the detection model that is hit
items.description_zh: 命中识别模型的数据标签对象

Id.description_en:
The data tag ID of the detection model. Valid values:
101: personal sensitive information.
102: personal information.
103: important data
Id.description_zh:
识别模型的数据标签ID。
101：个人敏感信息。
102：个人信息。
103：重要数据

Name.description_en:
The data tag name of the detection model. Valid values:
Personal sensitive information.
Personal information.
Important data
Name.description_zh:
识别模型的数据标签名称。
个人敏感信息。
个人信息。
重要数据

RiskLevelId.description_en:
The risk level ID of the OSS storage object. Valid values:
1: No sensitive data is detected.
2: Level 1 sensitive data.
3: Level 2 sensitive data.
4: Level 3 sensitive data.
5: Level 4 sensitive data
RiskLevelId.description_zh:
OSS存储对象的风险等级ID。
1：未识别到敏感数据。
2：1级敏感数据。
3：2级敏感数据。
4：3级敏感数据。
5：4级敏感数据

RiskLevelName.description_en: The risk level name of the OSS storage object
RiskLevelName.description_zh: OSS存储对象的风险等级名称

RuleName.description_en: The name of the sensitive data detection rule that is hit
RuleName.description_zh: 命中敏感数据识别规则的名称
